text:
1	# Hello
2	
3	A single static page. No build step, no dependencies. It renders one centered
4	greeting — "Hello, and welcome." — on a dark background, and nothing else. The
5	favicon is a white "H" on a rounded square in the same dark colour as the page.
6	
7	## Files
8	
9	| Path | Purpose |
10	| --- | --- |
11	| `index.html` | The home page — markup, inline styles, and a nav to the other pages |
12	| `about.html` | A short paragraph on what this repo is |
13	| `files.html` | The repo's markdown files, one line each on what they hold |
14	| `favicon.svg` | Favicon for modern browsers |
15	| `favicon.ico` | Fallback favicon for browsers that ignore the SVG |
16	
17	## Run it locally
18	
19	Open the file directly:
20	
21	```sh
22	open index.html
23	```
24	
25	Or serve it over HTTP, which matches production more closely:
26	
27	```sh
28	python3 -m http.server 8000
29	# then visit http://localhost:8000
30	```
31	
32	## Deploy
33	
34	Live at **https://suleimansh.github.io/test-project/**
35	
36	Deployment is GitHub Pages, driven by `.github/workflows/deploy.yml`. Every push to
37	`main` publishes the site; it can also be run by hand from the Actions tab.
38	
39	One-time setup is already done on `suleimansh/test-project`: the remote exists and
40	the Pages source is set to GitHub Actions (**Settings → Pages → Build and
41	deployment → Source: GitHub Actions**). A fresh fork or clone needs both steps
42	repeated before its first deploy will publish.
43	
44	Because this is a *project* Pages site, it is served from the `/test-project/`
45	subpath rather than the domain root. Asset links in `index.html` are therefore
46	relative (`favicon.ico`, not `/favicon.ico`) — a root-absolute path resolves to
47	`suleimansh.github.io/favicon.ico` and 404s.
48	
49	The workflow copies only `index.html`, `about.html`, `files.html`, `favicon.ico`,
50	and `favicon.svg` into the published artifact. The repository root is *not* deployed wholesale — anything not
51	in that list (for example `.the-framework/`, which holds internal run logs and
52	analysis notes) is never reachable from the public site. If you add a file that
53	should be served, add it to the `Stage site` step or it will not ship.
